objects: players and phased-in permanents selected for ordinary Proliferate
entering Planeswalker or Battle card and its prospective permanent
events: put a positive fixed quantity of named counters on one source or direct-target battlefield permanent
put the same fixed quantity of one named counter on each member of a bounded direct-target set
put the same fixed quantity of one named counter on every member of one represented public battlefield set
put one additional counter of every existing kind on each subject selected for one ordinary Proliferate instruction
nested counter placement created by a represented replacement
mandatory intrinsic Planeswalker loyalty or Battle defense self-replacement during battlefield entry
state_reads: current object identity and target legality
canonical prospective type set and printed nonnegative integral loyalty or defense
state_writes: permanent or player counter quantity after every applicable replacement choice has resolved
timing: inside the containing zone-change replacement tree before battlefield-entry commit
targets: every selected target is revalidated on resolution
an instruction with some legal targets resolves only for those targets
an instruction whose originally selected targets are all illegal does not resolve
up-to target sets may legally contain zero distinct targets
choices: affected permanent controller chooses among competing represented quantity replacements
hidden_information: seat packet exposes only visible replacement labels and IDs, not event payload, object ID, or replacement journal
apnap: simultaneous placements requiring choices are collected in APNAP order
replacement_effects: reviewed fixed integral multiplication and addition apply to effect-generated permanent-counter placements
a containing event is exhausted before its nested counter event
intrinsic loyalty and defense are mandatory self-replacements whose nested counter event follows a later destination replacement
zone_change: zone changes clear counters from the new object
source_leaves: targeted effects can resolve if their source leaves

variants: fixed positive counters on this permanent or exact card-name source
fixed positive counters on one direct permanent-type or validated creature-subtype target
bounded up-to sets of direct permanent-type targets with closed controller predicates
closed mandatory public battlefield sets with represented type, controller, token, and counter predicates
fixed controller relation and source exclusion predicates
one ordinary Proliferate instruction over players and permanents
printed Planeswalker loyalty and Battle defense on entry

implementation.component: closed fixed-counter single-target, bounded target-set, affected-set, Proliferate, and card-form entry compilers; strict semantic and replacement continuations; typed target and set coordinators; counter_placement mutation owner; semantic_runtime counter and zone replacements; and represented producers
implementation.supported_slice: Mandatory fixed positive named counters on one source, one direct battlefield permanent target, one bounded up-to set of direct permanent targets, or one closed mandatory public battlefield set through spell, trigger, and activated contexts; one ordinary Proliferate instruction over eligible players and permanents; and printed nonnegative integral Planeswalker loyalty or Battle defense on entry.

known_blockers: Support shorthand and optional, variable, distributed, multi-counter, dynamic, subtype-qualified, combat-qualified, modal, conditional, and compound target-set instructions remain residual
cumulative upkeep, loyalty costs, and other rule-action counter producers are not yet migrated to the shared transaction
token Planeswalker or Battle entry with an applicable quantity replacement remains fail closed until token creation can suspend atomically
fractional, halving, dynamic-quantity, movement, removal, prevention, and other enters-with-counter replacement families remain unsupported
counter type rules beyond existing power/toughness and loyalty consumers are incomplete
